8	---
9	
10	## Summary
11	
12	- `make build` gains a `BUILD_TARGET` selector. `local` — the default — keeps today's plain `docker build` invocation and its `$(VERSION)` tag. Naming a cluster instead renders a Kubernetes Job, applies it to that cluster's `build` namespace, waits for it, and reports the result.
13	- The Job clones the requested git ref, builds `linux/amd64` with rootless BuildKit, and pushes `docker.io/bborbe/openldap:<TAG>` using a credential mounted inside the pod.
14	- Five files land under `hack/`, copied verbatim from pinned source refs: `build-cluster.sh`, `cluster-alias.sh` and `build-job.yaml` from `bborbe/agent-task-executor@91a7e64e160f30be8af0aea64635e1e11bc86731` (v0.57.4); `build-cluster-bootstrap.sh` and `dockerconfig.json.tpl` from `bborbe/go-skeleton@eb050aa20bb6194d8af7e47baf8880df789bd1ca` (3 commits after v0.8.3). The YOLO container mounts only this repository and `.dark-factory.yaml` declares no `extraMounts`, so the prompt must carry the file bodies inline rather than reach a sibling repo.
15	- `upload` and `clean` become no-ops for a cluster target — the cluster arm already pushed, and nothing was built on the invoking host.
16	- The local arm's observable behaviour is unchanged: same `docker build` arguments, same `docker.io/bborbe/openldap:1.3.0` tag, image present in the local Docker store.
17	
18	## Problem
19	
20	Every `bborbe` image build today runs `docker build` on whichever machine invokes `make build`. This repository's `Makefile` has a single `build` target with no selector, so its image can be produced on one Mac and nowhere else. That serialises the release on a machine that may be asleep or have its Docker daemon stopped, and it is why `openldap` sits in the un-migrated half of the build-cluster rollout.
21	
22	The deployment already depends on this image being reproducible elsewhere: `nuke/teamvault/k8s/ldap-sts.yaml:21,40` renders `${REGISTRY_HOST}/bborbe/openldap:1.3.0`, and that name is populated by nuke's mirror step from the `docker.io` image this build produces.
23	
24	## Goal
25	
26	`make build` with no `BUILD_TARGET` behaves exactly as it does today. `make build BUILD_TARGET=<cluster> REF=<git-ref> VERSION=<tag>` creates a Job in that cluster which clones the ref, builds and pushes the image; the make target blocks until the Job reaches a terminal state and exits non-zero if it failed. The Job spec is one reusable, parameterized file at `hack/build-job.yaml` that nothing else in the repo adopts as deploy state.
27	
28	## Non-goals
29	
30	- Migrating any other repository. This is `openldap` only.
31	- Changing image naming, the `docker.io/bborbe/openldap` repository, or the local arm's `$(VERSION)` tag and its `1.3.0` default.
32	- Loading the built image back to the invoking machine (`--load`). Rejected, not deferred: it keeps the push credential on the local machine.
33	- Pushing to the in-cluster registries, and the nuke mirror pin bump in `nuke/base/Makefile:23`. The mirror stays a mirror.
34	- Multi-arch images. `linux/amd64` only, matching the cluster nodes.
35	- Provisioning cluster namespaces or credentials as a deliverable. `hack/build-cluster-bootstrap.sh` runs them, once, as a prerequisite.
36	- Release-time build triggering. That is a separate concern.
37	- A buildx Kubernetes driver path, a Kaniko path, or any second executor. One executor ships.
38	- Adding `BUILD_*` build args to the `Dockerfile`. It consumes none today and needs none.
39	- An `ALLOW_DEFAULT_VERSION` escape hatch. `agent-task-executor` ships one as a bypass of the defaulted-`VERSION` guard; this repo takes the guard without the bypass, so the refusal is unconditional.
40	
41	## Assumptions
42	
43	- The cluster aliases are `sun`, `nukedev` and `nukeprod`; `hack/cluster-alias.sh` maps them to `~/.kube/sun` (context `default`), `~/.kube/nuke-dev` (context `nuke-dev`) and `~/.kube/nuke-prod` (context `nuke-prod`). Any other value is treated as a plain kubectl context in the ambient kubeconfig.
44	- The `build` namespace and the `buildkit-push` secret are provisioned once by `hack/build-cluster-bootstrap.sh <cluster>`; this spec does not create them and the Job cannot push without them.
45	- `crane`, `teamvault-cli` (with a Keychain login for the docker.io push account) and a `kubectl` wrapper for the target cluster are present on the operator's host.
46	- The target cluster can reach `github.com` and `docker.io`.
47	- The operator runs the cluster-arm evidence commands against the same cluster the Job was created in, named by the wrapper matching `BUILD_TARGET`.
48	- The scratch tag passed as `VERSION` is lowercase and DNS-safe, so the derived Job name equals `build-<scratch-tag>`.
49	
50	## Acceptance Criteria
51	
52	- [ ] **`BUILD_TARGET` defaults to `local` and the local recipe is unchanged** — evidence: `make -n build` with no `BUILD_TARGET` emits `docker build --no-cache --rm=true --platform=linux/amd64 -t docker.io/bborbe/openldap:1.3.0 .` as its only command line, and its output contains no occurrence of `hack/build-cluster.sh`.
53	- [ ] **The local arm still produces an image in the local Docker store** — evidence: after `docker rmi docker.io/bborbe/openldap:1.3.0`, `make build` exits 0 and `docker image inspect -f '{{.Id}}' docker.io/bborbe/openldap:1.3.0` exits 0 printing a non-empty `sha256:` id.
54	- [ ] **The cluster arm refuses a defaulted `VERSION`** — evidence: `make build BUILD_TARGET=<cluster> REF=<full-sha>` (no `VERSION` on the command line) exits non-zero, its stderr contains `the cluster arm needs an explicit VERSION`, and `kubectl<wrapper> -n build get jobs -o name | wc -l` is the same before and after the attempt.
55	- [ ] **Post-Deploy (Rung-3):** a cluster target creates a Job that completes and pushes — evidence: `make build BUILD_TARGET=<cluster> REF=<full-sha> VERSION=<scratch-tag>` exits 0; `kubectl<wrapper> -n build get job build-<scratch-tag> -o jsonpath='{.status.succeeded}'` returns `1`; `kubectl<wrapper> -n build get pod -l job-name=build-<scratch-tag> -o jsonpath='{.items[0].spec.nodeName}'` returns a non-empty node name; `crane digest docker.io/bborbe/openldap:<scratch-tag>` returns a `sha256:` digest.
56	  - `deploy_check:` `kubectlsun -n build get namespace build -o jsonpath='{.metadata.name}'`
57	  - `deploy_target:` `build`
58	
59	  This check asserts the `build` namespace exists, not deployment freshness — the change ships build tooling and deploys nothing, so a pass here means the target namespace is present, never that a new build was deployed.
60	- [ ] **The pushed reference is the repository the deployment consumes** — evidence: the `make -n build BUILD_TARGET=<cluster> REF=<full-sha> VERSION=<scratch-tag>` output contains `IMAGE='docker.io/bborbe/openldap'` and `DOCKER_REGISTRY='docker.io'`, and the digest recorded in the previous criterion resolves at exactly `docker.io/bborbe/openldap:<scratch-tag>`.
61	- [ ] **The cluster-built image is absent from the invoking machine** — evidence: `docker image inspect docker.io/bborbe/openldap:<scratch-tag>` fails with `No such image`.
62	- [ ] **All five `hack/` files are present, parse, and carry the copied hardening** — evidence: `test -f` succeeds for `hack/build-cluster.sh`, `hack/cluster-alias.sh`, `hack/build-job.yaml`, `hack/build-cluster-bootstrap.sh` and `hack/dockerconfig.json.tpl`; `bash -n` exits 0 for each of the three scripts; `grep -c 'contains a newline' hack/build-cluster.sh` returns ≥ 1; `grep -c 'rendered_namespace' hack/build-cluster.sh` returns ≥ 1; `grep -c 'automountServiceAccountToken: false' hack/build-job.yaml` returns ≥ 1; `grep -c 'safe.directory' hack/build-job.yaml` returns ≥ 1; `grep -c 'oci-worker-no-process-sandbox' hack/build-job.yaml` returns ≥ 1.
63	- [ ] **`upload` and `clean` are no-ops for a cluster target** — evidence: `make upload BUILD_TARGET=<cluster> VERSION=<scratch-tag>` exits 0 and its output contains `nothing to do`; `make clean BUILD_TARGET=<cluster>` exits 0 and its output contains `nothing to do`.
64	- [ ] **`CHANGELOG.md` carries an `## Unreleased` section naming the change** — evidence: `awk '/^## /{print; exit}' CHANGELOG.md` prints `## Unreleased`, and `grep -A6 '^## Unreleased' CHANGELOG.md | grep -c 'BUILD_TARGET'` returns ≥ 1.
65	- [ ] **`make precommit` and `make test` exist and run without a Docker daemon** — evidence: `make precommit` exits 0 and `make test` exits 0 on a host where `docker` is absent or the daemon is stopped, and neither target's output contains `docker build`.

68	
69	### Container-executable (runs inside the YOLO container at prompt time)
70	
71	- `make -n build` — prints the unchanged `docker build` line and no `hack/build-cluster.sh`
72	- `make -n build BUILD_TARGET=nukeprod REF=<sha> VERSION=<scratch-tag>` — prints the `hack/build-cluster.sh` invocation with `IMAGE='docker.io/bborbe/openldap'`

76	- `grep -c 'rendered_namespace' hack/build-cluster.sh` — returns ≥ 1
77	- `grep -c 'automountServiceAccountToken: false' hack/build-job.yaml` — returns ≥ 1
78	- `grep -c 'safe.directory' hack/build-job.yaml` — returns ≥ 1
79	- `grep -c '^BUILD_TARGET' Makefile` — returns ≥ 1
80	- `grep -cE '^[[:space:]]*hack/build-cluster\.sh' Makefile` — returns ≥ 1
81	- `awk '/^## /{print; exit}' CHANGELOG.md` — prints `## Unreleased`
82	- `make precommit` — exits 0 with no Docker daemon present
83	- `make test` — exits 0 with no Docker daemon present
84	
85	### Operator-executable (runs on the host after PR merge)
86

147	
148	- The push credential exists only as a cluster secret, mounted into the build pod. It is never written to the invoking machine, never passed as a make variable, and never printed.
